verdict.rationale: Better Stack mentions an incident timeline and generates an automated post-mortem from that timeline plus Slack. Incident actions such as create, acknowledge and resolve can be taken directly from Slack, which suggests alerts, actions and chat context are tied to the incident record. However, nothing describes what the timeline actually captures, and nothing shows it can be edited or annotated afterwards. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic capture of alerts, responder actions and chat decisions into the timeline; ability to edit or annotate the timeline after the incident; hands-on or independent corroboration.
